articles.description: Unrivaled's second season featured ups and downs in terms of viewership, with the playoffs averaging 258,000 viewers on TNT and TruTv, down 9% from last year.
articles.headline: Unrivaled sells out arenas but sees ratings dip in 2nd season

articles.description: The WNBA sent a CBA proposal to the union a day after the league received one from the players, a source told ESPN's Alexa Philippou.
articles.headline: Source: WNBA sends counterproposal to players ahead of deadline

images.caption: The WNBA and players union have until a Jan. 9 deadline to determine next steps as they look to complete a new deal.
images.name: WNBA logo ball [1296x729]

articles.description: WNBA star Caitlin Clark is gearing up for her U.S. national team debut in next week's FIBA World Cup qualifier in Puerto Rico.
articles.headline: Caitlin Clark set for Team USA debut after 8-month injury layoff

images.caption: Alexa Philippou joins "SportsCenter" to give an update on Caitlin Clark and the rest of the Team USA training camp.
images.name: Youthful Team USA starts training camp ahead of Olympics

articles.description: WNBPA vice president Breanna Stewart said Friday that the letter to players' union executive director Terri Jackson earlier this week was intended to "get the entire [executive committee] back on track" to get the best CBA possible.
articles.headline: WNBPA's Stewart: Letter not meant to undermine Jackson

images.caption: Stephen A. Smith says the WNBA must be fair and needs to take care of its players.
images.name: Stephen A. calls for the WNBA to take care of its players

articles.description: Los Angeles Sparks' guard, Barker, gives advice to NCAA hoopers, lists who has impressed her the most from this season and opens up about how the SEC helped ready her for the W.
articles.headline: Sarah Ashlee Barker reflects on her Bama legacy at SEC WBB Tournament

articles.description: Dallas Wings guard Arike Ogunbowale was arrested and charged with misdemeanor battery in Miami early Thursday morning after she allegedly punched a man in the face, according to police records.
articles.headline: Arike Ogunbowale arrested on battery charge after Unrivaled win

articles.description: Monique Billings and Rae Burrell were added Thursday to the U.S. women's basketball roster for the FIBA World Cup qualifier next week in Puerto Rico.
articles.headline: U.S. adds Billings, Burrell for FIBA World Cup qualifier

images.alt: Monique Billings #25 of the Dallas Wings dribbles the ball during the game against the Phoenix Mercury on May 25, 2024 at Footprint Center in Phoenix, Arizona.
images.caption: Monique Billings has made the most of her opportunity in Dallas.
images.name: Monique Billings [600x400]

articles.description: As CBA negotiations linger, the time to conduct drafts and free agency gets shorter. We asked WNBA GMs how they're preparing.
articles.headline: As CBA negotiations linger, how are WNBA GMs preparing for 2026 season?

images.caption: Napheesa Collier joins "SportsCenter" to discuss where negotiations stand between the WNBA and its players regarding the March 10 deadline for a new CBA.
images.name: Collier: 'Both sides are working really hard to get a deal done'

articles.description: Despite 40 points from Kelsey Plum, Breanna Stewart led the Mist past the Phantom for the 2026 Unrivaled title.
articles.headline: Unrivaled playoffs 2026: Schedule, teams, stats to know

images.caption: Breanna Stewart's 32 points helped lead the Mist to the 2026 Unrivaled title in the 3-on-3 league's second season.
images.name: Breanna Stewart [1296x729]

images.caption: Kelsey Plum scored 40 points on Wednesday, hitting 14-for-21 field goals and 6-for-7 3-pointers.
images.name: Kelsey Plum [1296x729]

articles.description: Despite a brilliant 40-point performance from Kelsey Plum, Breanna Stewart and Mist topped Phantom 80-74 in the championship game to become the queens of Unrivaled for 2026.
articles.headline: Stewart drops 32 as Mist overcome Plum's 40 to win Unrivaled title

images.caption: Breanna Stewart and Arike Ogunbowale triumphed in Wednesday's Unrivaled final, which with a labor agreement in doubt could be the last professional women's game in the U.S. for a while.
images.name: Breanna Stewart [600x400]

articles.description: The WNBPA's executive committee said that it remains "united" and that a recent player survey reaffirms the league's latest proposal for a new CBA "is not worth taking."
articles.headline: WNBPA exec committee says latest CBA proposal 'not worth taking'

articles.description: WNBPA executive committee members Kelsey Plum and Breanna Stewart wrote a three-page letter Monday to players' union executive director Terri Jackson expressing "serious concerns about how the PA is handling the current negotiations" for a new CBA.
articles.headline: Plum, Stewart raise concerns over WNBPA's handling of CBA talks

images.caption: In a letter, Breanna Stewart and Kelsey Plum said they're "concerned about the impact that a standoff or work stoppage would have on the overall financial health of the league" and believe it's time to negotiate off the WNBA's revenue-sharing proposals.
images.name: Breanna Stewart #30 of the New York Liberty and Kelsey Plum [600x400]

images.caption: Napheesa Collier joins "SportsCenter" to discuss where negotiations stand between the WNBA and its players regarding the March 10 deadline for a new CBA.
images.name: Collier: 'Both sides are working really hard to get a deal done'

articles.description: Phantom BC and Mist will face off in the Unrivaled championship game Wednesday night after both delivered entertaining semifinal wins in front of a sellout crowd at Barclays Center on Monday.
articles.headline: Phantom, Mist to vie for Unrivaled title after semifinal wins

images.caption: "This is my home. Once I knew [the semifinals in Brooklyn] was happening, I was like, 'My team has to be here. I want to be playing in this game,'" said Breanna Stewart. And then Arike Ogunbowale's game-winning 3 sent Mist to the championship game.
images.name: Arike Ogunbowale #24 and Breanna Stewart [600x400]

articles.description: Kelsey Plum said the CBA offer from the league to the WNBPA is a "significant win," but negotiations should continue and "a strike would be the worst thing for both sides."
articles.headline: Kelsey Plum sees WNBA's offer as a 'win,' but CBA talks continue
